result.summary: IMPLEMENTATION WRITTEN, NOT COMPILED. No mix command ran: the mutex was held by another session for polls 1-9, and free memory stayed below the 1.5 GB floor for all 20 polls (0.28-1.23 GB; final 1.03 GB at 17:49Z). So format --check-formatted, MIX_ENV=test compile --warnings-as-errors, mix letflow.check_scope_node_paths_writers, migrations and tests were all SKIPPED. Before SECURITY-REVIEWER, re-dispatch ELIXIR-DEV (or TEST-RUNNER) to run them when >= 1.5 GB (compile/format) / >= 4 GB (tests) is free. Non-mix checks run: a grep of the scan's two rules over lib/letflow/modules and priv/modules finds 0 hits each; the files containing module_owner( under lib/**/*.ex are exactly managed_types.ex and installs.ex, and the Owner struct appears only in managed_types.ex (T-34 shape). DEVIATIONS: (1) migration versions 20261014100001/100002, not 20261014000001/000002 (OQ-1: origin/main already has 20261014000001_create_script_rules; open PR #2565 has 20261014000002_create_script_policy); a later rebase conflicts in the tenant_provisioning manifest tail and tenant_fixture.ex's table list (mechanical). (2) Added public ManagedTypes.managed_name?/1 (one copy of the name regex, shared by Catalog rule 7) and ScopeNodePaths.max_depth/0 (shared with Consistency). (3) The fixture pack holds 8 types and the manifest declares 7 as managed, per design 2.8 (the brief said six). (4) The advisory-lock and LOCK TABLE Repo.query! calls take no prefix: option, because a raw query's prefix is meaningless; every Ecto Repo call has prefix:. (5) Fixture record helpers use the fixed system actor 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 (RecordDeadlineSweep precedent), since the design's signatures carry no actor.
